passed: 288 controlled actual-code fights cover all four bosses, three characters and upgrades 0/1/3/5 at 120Hz and 60Hz, comparing original, requested and final HP.
Unupgraded HP/TTK remain unchanged; every sampled upgraded character kills faster than its unupgraded counterpart at both time steps.
All 72 character/region/level spawn combinations have correct hp/maxHp; changing upgrades mid-combat never changes existing boss HP.
The boss health bar renders against the snapshotted maxHp; existing collision/reward/progression paths finish every fight without JS errors.

method.aim: Exact centre aim each simulation tick; actual boss movement, attacks, projectile spread/homing and hit tests; player stationary and invulnerable. Start with empty bullets, zero fire cooldown, existing 1.5s boss transition.
method.before: Unscaled HP using current weapon rules (including current Tanko damage1.5); only initial hp/maxHp overridden. This is an HP-only comparison, not the previous Tanko combat version.
method.requested: Initial proposed linear 1 + 0.2 * upgrade; only initial HP overridden in test memory.
method.after: Actual product spawn HP, without test override.
method.limits: Controlled reproducible simulation in a real browser, not human difficulty or physical-device frame-rate measurement. 120Hz fixed step; a second 60Hz matrix checks the conclusion.

limits: Physical Galaxy/Samsung Internet and human aiming/latency/weapon balance are not tested. HP-only scaling cannot make every upgraded character equally fast without changing protected attacks.
